title: Invertibility of a completed affine comparison realization
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $J,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves. Assume $f$ is an isomorphism over $Y\setminus V(K)$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix an adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a coherent formal $J$-system $G$, coherent $F$ on $X$, an isomorphism $\beta:f^*G\simeq F^\wedge$, and coherence of $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $\kappa:(f_*F)^\wedge\to f_*(F^\wedge)$ have $\pi_n\kappa_n=f_*(\pi_n)$ and let $\alpha:G\to(f_*F)^\wedge$ have $\alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta_{G_n}f_*(\beta_n)$ at every positive level. For an affine $U$, put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $L=K(U)R$, and let $Q$ be the ideal sheaf of $L$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$. For any coherent $A,D$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$, $c:A\to D$, and $B$-module limit-to-sections isomorphisms $e_A,e_D$ with $(\varprojlim\alpha_n)e_D=e_A\operatorname{Res}_B^R\Gamma(c)$, the restriction of $c$ to $\operatorname{Spec}R\setminus V(L)$ is invertible. No objects or isomorphisms are supplied by this assertion.

proof.text: First use uniqueness of adjunctions for the same functors to absorb the natural automorphism relating the supplied and standard units into beta, preserving beta being an isomorphism and the alpha equation. Restrict to U=Spec B and base change to Spec R. Noetherian completion is flat and has unchanged positive ideal-power quotients. Degree-zero canonical flat base change identifies pushforwards and their quotient and adjunction maps. Quotient projections are epi, and formal functions identifies lim kappa as invertible; hence the two equations uniquely identify lim alpha before and after completion.

Algebraize the pulled-back formal source over complete R by the affine equivalence. Coherence of tensor pullback and compatibility with completion permit full faithfulness over the proper source to lift beta and its inverse to inverse coherent maps. Proper coherent direct image gives a coherent target. The comparison equations identify alpha with completion of the adjunction map followed by pushforward of this lifted isomorphism.

Over the complement of V(L), the base-changed f is an isomorphism, so its adjunction unit and pushforward of the lifted beta are invertible. This proves invertibility there of the canonical coherent comparison. Any chosen adjunction for these same functors differs from the standard one by a natural automorphism, so this invertibility conclusion applies to the supplied adjunction as well.

Identify the supplied c with the canonical comparison by the square. Finite R-modules are complete for J(U)R. Any B-linear map between such modules is R-linear: for r∈R choose a_n∈B congruent modulo the nth ideal power, use B-linearity modulo that power and Hausdorffness to pass to the equality at every n. Thus the two B-linear section isomorphisms comparing the supplied and canonical models are R-linear. The affine coherent/finite-module equivalence lifts them to coherent isomorphisms, conjugating c to the canonical comparison. Restriction preserves isomorphisms, yielding the assertion. Preservation of powers under a B-linear map follows because J(U)^nR times a module equals J(U)^n times its underlying B-module, using finite generation of that ideal.

    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶

        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
      let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
      let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
      let L := (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
      let Q := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop

      ∀ (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj),

        ∀ eD : limit (((completion Y J).obj
